requirements.title: Debit Card Controls Workflow

requirements.title: Transaction Processing Workflow
requirements.description: Transaction initiation, transaction PIN check, transaction processing, and real-time push notification

requirements.title: Digital Banking App Workflow
requirements.description: User navigates through the app, performing various financial actions, such as transferring money, checking investments, tracking budget, and managing cards

requirements.title: Send Money to Contact Workflow
requirements.description: Select recipient, enter transfer amount, confirm transfer, backend processing, push notifications, and transaction appears in activity feed

requirements.title: Buy Fractional Stock/ETF Workflow
requirements.description: Search for stock/ETF, select order type, enter dollar amount or share quantity, confirm order, execution confirmation, and portfolio updated

requirements.title: Split Bill with Group Workflow
requirements.description: Enter total bill amount, add participants, select split options, review and send split request, participants pay their share, and organizer's dashboard shows real-time payment status

requirements.title: Debit Card Data Model with Transaction Entity
requirements.description: Debit card transactions with foreign key relationships to merchant categories, locations, and reward categories. PostgreSQL with row-level security (RLS) for multi-tenant isolation.
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a scalable data model, so that we can support a large number of debit card transactions securely

requirements.title: Rewards Program with Cashback Entity
requirements.description: Cashback rewards with foreign key relationships to transaction entities, and weekly cashback deposits to savings accounts, using Elasticsearch CDC indexing for real-time search.
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a scalable rewards program, so that we can support a large number of debit card users

requirements.title: Digital Banking App Data Model
requirements.description: User, Account, Transaction, Card, Transfer, Investment, and SavingsGoal entities with defined fields and relationships
requirements.user_story: As a system architect, I want a scalable data model, so that we can support a large number of users and transactions
acceptance_criteria: All entities have defined fields and relationships

test_steps.expected_result: User is created with a unique ID

assumptions: AWS KMS for encryption key management

requirements.title: Savings Goal Data Model
requirements.description: Savings goal entity with target amount, target date, and progress tracking, utilizing a relational database such as PostgreSQL for storage
requirements.user_story: As a user, I want to create savings goals with target amounts and dates, so that I can track my progress
acceptance_criteria: Savings goal creation with valid target amount and date

test_steps.expected_result: Goal is created with correct target amount and date

requirements.title: Card Controls Integration with Mobile App
requirements.description: Instant card freeze/unfreeze functionality integrated with mobile app using REST API, OAuth 2.0 authentication, and JWT tokens.
requirements.user_story: As a mobile app user, I want to freeze/unfreeze my debit card instantly, so that I can prevent unauthorized transactions
assumptions: Mobile app available on iOS and Android

requirements.title: ATM Access with Fee-Free ATM Finder

acceptance_criteria: Map displays correctly on mobile app

requirements.title: Sequence Flow: P2P Instant Transfer
requirements.description: Mobile App -> Auth Service: Biometric verification for transfer, Auth Service -> Mobile App: Session token validated, Mobile App -> Transfer Service: POST /api/transfers {recipient_id, amount, memo}

test_steps.test_data: Valid transfer amount and recipient information

Valid transfer amount and recipient information
